Privacy · Effective [EFFECTIVE DATE]

Privacy policy

Isocline keeps your records on your device. Isocline Labs does not collect them and cannot read them.

What the app stores

Doses, lab results, journal entries and your settings are stored on your iPhone and Apple Watch. There is no account to create and nothing to sign in to.

iCloud sync

If iCloud Sync is on, your records are also kept in your private iCloud database, under your Apple ID, so they reach your other devices. That database is yours. Isocline Labs has no access to it. You can turn sync off in Settings, under Privacy & Data.

What we collect

Nothing. The app contains no analytics, no advertising and no third-party code. Beyond Apple's iCloud and App Store services, it does not connect to the internet.

Purchases

Isocline Plus is a subscription sold through the App Store. Apple handles the payment. Isocline Labs never sees your card or billing details.

Reminders

Dose reminders are scheduled on your device. By default a reminder names no medication, dose or body part.

Your copy

You can export everything as CSV or JSON from Settings. Deleting the app removes its records from that device. [CONFIRM: HOW ICLOUD COPIES ARE REMOVED]

This website

isocline.app sets no cookies, runs no analytics and loads nothing from other companies. The pages are served by Cloudflare, which processes each request, including its IP address, in order to deliver it.

If you leave an email address on the home page, the address and the time you left it are stored in a database on Cloudflare. It is used to send one notice when the app is available, then deleted. To have it removed sooner, write to support@isocline.app. [CONFIRM BEFORE PUBLISHING]

Contact

Questions about this policy go to support@isocline.app. Isocline is made by Isocline Labs LLC, [MAILING ADDRESS].
